purpose: does causal market structure add information beyond OHLCV14? One cell: one information set, one model, four temporal folds

code.note: source_digest covers every repository module this process imported and is what nn.p2b_compare requires cells to agree on; revision and dirty are recorded beside it because neither one alone says what code ran

checked: shared spine arrays by object identity
identical fee, slippage and cost threshold
identical sample-index arrays per fold and block
checked_per_view: every feature column equals the column it was assembled from
the join was re-derived independently — see join_evidence

information_parity.flatten_order: column j = timestep t * n_features + feature f, t oldest first
information_parity.sample_construction: nn.dataset.build_windows, reached through nn.train.prepare_research_windows (train and inner validation) and nn.train.score_frozen_split (outer validation) — the same calls nn.benchmark makes for P2a
information_parity.scaling: nn.dataset.StandardScaler fitted on the fold's training rows only and applied unchanged to inner and outer validation

threshold_selection.objective: maximise net return after round-trip costs on the inner-validation block, subject to at least min_trades realised trades; falls back to the most permissive grid point when no candidate clears the floor

tuning: none (predeclared fixed configurations, reused from P2a)

compatibility_notes: device='cpu' is XGBoost 2.x's replacement for the removed gpu_id/predictor arguments; n_jobs=1 for reproducible CPU behaviour

threading.reason: BLAS reductions are order-dependent, so a multi-threaded lbfgs fit is not reproducible across machines with different core counts

importance.aggregated_over: summed across the 64 timesteps of each feature, inverting column j = timestep t * n_features + feature f

selection.objective: maximise net return after round-trip costs on the inner-validation block, subject to at least min_trades realised trades; falls back to the most permissive grid point when no candidate clears the floor

inner_validation_trading.annualised_sharpe_reason: unavailable: no market context (close/date series) supplied
inner_validation_trading.sharpe_basis: unavailable: no market context (close/date series) supplied

trading.sharpe_basis: candle-level portfolio returns (equity unchanged while flat, marked to market while a position is open, both cost sides charged when they are paid), annualised by sqrt(candles_per_year) over elapsed wall-clock time, with a zero return for each calendar interval absent from the processed dataset

economic_references.note: Economic reference policies, not models and not statistical baselines. A strategy that beats majority-class and momentum but loses to CASH lost money.

cash.description: no position at any time; no trades, no fees, no slippage
cash.per_trade_sharpe_reason: undefined: no trades, so the portfolio never moved
cash.annualised_sharpe_reason: undefined: the return series has no variance
cash.sharpe_basis: undefined: the return series has no variance

buy_and_hold.description: buy at the close of the first scored candle, hold, sell at the close of the candle that closes the last scored sample's label horizon
buy_and_hold.window: continuous market span (not the scored-sample set)
buy_and_hold.cost_model: one round trip charged once over the whole hold
buy_and_hold.per_trade_sharpe_reason: undefined: a single trade has no dispersion to measure
buy_and_hold.annualised_sharpe_reason: unavailable: the hold spans 85 calendar interval(s) absent from the processed dataset. What price did in between is not recorded there, so a candle-level series comparable to the strategy's cannot be built without inventing a path
buy_and_hold.sharpe_basis: unavailable: the hold spans 85 calendar interval(s) absent from the processed dataset. What price did in between is not recorded there, so a candle-level series comparable to the strategy's cannot be built without inventing a path
